method: Predicted win% = implied probability of the brief's fair price (published american odds shifted by the stated edge in cents), the src/lib/winprob.ts convention. Realized win% excludes pushes.

fit.method: Isotonic regression (pool-adjacent-violators, weighted, monotonic non-decreasing) on the individual decided picks: raw predicted % -> fitted %. Step function: the fitted % of the first breakpoint whose upTo >= the raw %. Fitted values clamped to [5, 95]; blocks with support n<5 are pooled into their nearer-mean neighbor so no step rests on a handful of picks. Applied at display time only (src/lib/winprob.ts); raw model numbers stay in the feed.
